correctness.rationale: Exact Möbius composition gives a scalar fixed-point quadratic. Algebraically, difference of the two quota-ordered quadratics factors as -(H-L)(r-1)R(x), with exactly one positive root independent of H. A lower-root tie thus requires the unique linear-in-H fixed-point equation at this positive root; continuity gives at most one reversal on each connected physical interval. For r=3,K1=4,K2=1,L=1/5, both positive-cycle domains and all intermediate abundances are analytically certified across [1/4,1/2]; exact rational root intervals on the ends show opposite rankings, with equality at a verified radical quota H*. Checker replays symbolic and rational identities; no empirical finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2010 paper explicitly poses quota-order effects on persistence as a motivated harvest-management problem. The result supplies a genuinely structural uniqueness law for the initial-population basin boundary, a sharp achieved reversal and an exact obstruction, contrasting monotonically ordered transfer traces with non-monotonic basin preferences. It is not a routine parameter substitution, weak numerical gain, arbitrary slice, or mere exercise; it resolves a natural minimal two-season boundary with a full proof.
